description: CC0 music, ambience and sound effects. Fetch with `node scripts/audio-fetch.mjs` (downloads into assets/_audio_packs/, copies into assets/audio/). Both folders are gitignored; this manifest is committed.
notes: Every pack is CC0 1.0 (several OpenGameArt pages are dual/multi-licensed; we always take the CC0 option). No attribution is legally required, but assets/CREDITS-audio.md credits every author anyway.
Targets are paths under assets/audio/. Music is MP3/OGG as published (no re-encoding); a few short SFX are WAV. All three formats play in Chromium/Firefox via the Web Audio API or <audio>.

moods: mood -> tracks; the music player picks one (shuffle, avoid immediate repeat) and crossfades on mood change. loop:false tracks (victory fanfares) play once then fall back to the previous exploration mood.
ambience: optional looping beds layered under music at low volume (forest for Aurelmark wilds, swamp for the Gloamfen, dungeon drips underground).
sfx: event -> variants; the player picks a random variant (avoid immediate repeat) and may apply +/-5% playback-rate jitter.
Kenney zip URLs contain a content hash; if Kenney republishes a pack the URL changes and the sha256 check fails. Re-check the pack page (url) and update download.url + hashes with --write-hashes.
